summary: The D5 revert (f97a72f90, PM option C) closes ADV-P1-8. All nine money mutants fail at HEAD: pricing S7 (1,200 and a 3,500 typo), S9 answer 2, tutorRole.points.3 in th, S9 answer 3, features S5 body 3, and three sample pins from the restored files. The ADV-P1-1 FAQ mutants fail at HEAD too. The structure holds at the new class sums (K 3064, D1 67, D2 22, D4 6, R2 16 = 3175): 98 files with a row, e2e and i18n-cli not counted, the seven tutor-commission files in K rows only, no K case deleted, and every classification mutant caught. The errata are true, and classification.md and report.md state the D5 revert with its reason. No blocker. One report paragraph is stale after the revert (ADV-P1-12): the cut without the blog merge is now minus 28 cases, not plus 54. Route note: the route picker returned a barred DeepSeek route (reported by the orchestrator), so claude-agent/sonnet#xhigh was used as a substitution.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-P1-12 [Note] adversarial: report.md section 1 still says 'Without the blog merge, the cut is small' and quotes 81 cases (2.6 %) and 54 cases (1.7 %). Those figures come from the tree with D5 applied. After the revert the suite holds 3203 cases without the blog merge (1494 + 1709), which is 28 more than the 3175 baseline. The pilot cut comes entirely from the blog merge. Criterion (a) still passes, because the PM approved the merge and proof-blog-merge.log holds its breakage proof. Fix: update the paragraph.

Replacements M7a (a D1 row moved into K), M7b (revert note removed), M7c (a tutor-commission row moved to D5) and M7d (Summary back at K 2843) are all detected.

The Storytime file also keeps the F12 scanner controls (Thai month, school year), which are stricter and drop no pin. No restored file imports the D5 locale-key helper.

Sample of three more pins from the restored files: N1 pricing S1 body 2 (price-inclusion claim, en and th), N2 pricing S5 body (books priced per book, by quotation, en and th), N3 Reedy package-gated access claim (en FAQ answer and th page description). Each fails at HEAD: 5 cases, 5 cases, and 2 cases ('en: the Reedy FAQ answer is the package sentence only', 'th: the page Reedy description drops the Tutor-Advantage-only clause'). N3 is an access claim, not a price figure.

Non-blog count: 1494 + 1709 (cases removed by the blog merge, gate-257a6b0c.json: 3094 to 1385) = 3203, which is 28 above the 3175 baseline. Before the revert the pre-merge count without the blog merge was 3121 (a cut of 54).
